title: House tour, bake sale proceeds to benefit Women's Club of Milton Dec. 12 | Cape Gazette
text:
The Women’s Club of Milton will host its annual Holiday House Tour from 2 to 6 p.m., Saturday, Dec. 12, featuring nine private homes and three public buildings.
The event will take place rain, snow or shine and is the club’s largest annual fundraiser. Proceeds support WCOM community service initiatives and its scholarship program, which enrich the lives of others.
The women’s club will also hold a bake sale from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. that day during the Milton Holly Festival.The sale offers delicious home-baked goods and the club’s Milton Experience raffle tickets.
The homes on this year’s tour date from the 1870s to present day. Visitors may also explore three historic public buildings: the Milton Historical Society and Museum, Milton Town Hall and the Milton Arts Guild. Each site will be beautifully decorated for the season.
Advance tickets are now available through Venmo. Beginning Sunday, Nov. 1, they may also be purchased at the Mercantile at Milton and Lewes Gourmet in Lewes or reserved by calling 203-610-2443.
Tickets on tour day will be available from the Mercantile at Milton, and the Milton Historical Society and Museum.
Founded in 1890, the Women's Club of Milton is a member of the General Federation of Women's Clubs, one of the world’s oldest and largest women's service organizations dedicated to community improvement through volunteer service.
For more information, go to womensclubofmilton.org.
